title: DataCurrentness
description: ISO 25012-sourced data quality archetype — Currentness inherent data quality characteristic. The degree to which data has attributes that are of the right age in a specific context of use. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms governing data entities. Source: ISO/IEC 25012 (Inherent Data Quality — Currentness).

freshnessRequirement.description: Required data freshness. REAL_TIME = sub-second. NEAR_REAL_TIME = minutes. HOURLY/DAILY/WEEKLY = periodic refresh. ARCHIVAL = historical, no freshness requirement.

maxStaleness.description: Maximum acceptable age of data before it is considered stale. ISO 8601 duration (e.g., PT1H, P1D).

updateFrequency.description: Expected frequency of data updates from source. ISO 8601 duration.
